import re
LINE = re.compile(r'^(?P<ind>\s*)(?P<kind>class|def) (?P<name>\S+)(?: \[(?P<bases>.*)\])? (?P<lineno>\d+)\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    recs, used, stack = [], [], []
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        m = LINE.match(ln)
        if not m:
            continue
        ind = len(m.group('ind'))
        while stack and stack[-1][0] >= ind:
            stack.pop()
        recs.append({'kind': m.group('kind'), 'name': m.group('name'),
                     'parent': stack[-1][1] if stack else '', 'depth': len(stack),
                     'bases': m.group('bases') or '', 'lineno': m.group('lineno')})
        stack.append((ind, m.group('name')))
        used.append(i)
    return [{'name': 'definitions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': recs}]
